posts.text: ATHENS, GREECE, November 5, 2026 - Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. (the "Company" or "OET") (NYSE:ECO / OSE:OET), will report unaudited condensed financial results for the third quarter of 2026, after market close on the NYSE, on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, and a webcast will be held at 14:30 CET, on Thursday, November 12, 2026. Rapporten kommer altså rett etter 22. 11.11. Ikke 12.11 som Nordnet annonserer.
